item: banner-class system frames (1.26): the CLI's one-line notices draw as muted status lines instead of being dropped
branch: bannerLine(ev) in 50-blocks.js, dispatched from 70-events.js for notification / vcs_state_changed / code_change_published / memory_saved / memory_recall / permission_retry / scheduled_task_fire / away_summary / agents_killed / stop_hook_summary; task_summary pins the working verb; turn_duration is deliberately silent; each kind wears its glyph in the gutter (branch / link / bookmark / open dot, alert for warnings — option C picked by the user 2026-09-05 from a three-way render in the real panel); the first frame of each subtype is kept in window.__bannerSeen
provenance: Steps 1-3 carry VERBATIM frames MEASURED 2026-09-05 over stdio on 2.1.261 with the panel's own flags (scratchpad probe_banners.py): a `git commit` through Bash emitted vcs_state_changed{kind:'commit', branch:'master', cwd}; a `git push` to a bare remote emitted vcs_state_changed{kind:'push', branch:'master', cwd}; a Stop hook exiting 2 emitted notification{key:'stop-hook-error', text:'Stop hook error occurred · ctrl+o to see', priority:'immediate'} — and NO stop_hook_summary (the internal message has no stream-json translator arm). Steps 4-9 are SCHEMA-SHAPED (read from the 2.1.261 binary's zod definitions) and INFERRED: memory_saved / memory_recall / code_change_published / task_summary are engine-emitted through the same push as vcs_state_changed but need automemory extraction, a recognised forge remote (o5e allowlist) or the debounced classifier, none forceable here; agents_killed / permission_retry / scheduled_task_fire / away_summary / turn_duration are REPL-only (their only call sites are TUI transcript reducers; an interrupt with a live background agent, a mode switch over a parked ask and a /loop tick each produced none). NEGATIVE CONTROL: run against the sandbox still serving the pre-change build before the renderer landed — RUN 2026-09-05 (sandbox launched before the JS edit, fixture written first): 18 FAILED / 1 passed / 0 aborts — the one pass is the absence assert (turn_duration draws nothing), vacuous on both builds, every other assert discriminates. After the edit and a sandbox restart: 19/19; full harness 733/0 (714 + 19). GLYPH CONTROL 2026-09-05: the six glyph asserts were added while the sandbox still served the glyph-less build: 5 FAILED / 20 passed / 0 aborts — the five kind-glyph asserts discriminate, the "warning keeps the alert" one is a GUARD that passes on both builds (a first draft compared innerHTML to the raw constant and failed everywhere: the browser re-serialises SVG, so the constant is normalised through a scratch element). After the edit and a restart: 25/25; full harness 739/0. LINK-COLOUR CONTROL 2026-09-05: the anchor-colour assert was added while the sandbox still served the build without the .status a rule: 1 FAILED / 25 passed. After the CSS edit and a restart: 26/26; full harness 740/0.

steps.note: vcs commit (VERBATIM frame): one muted status line naming the branch

expect.why: exactly one line
kind + branch in plain words
a commit is not an error
first frame of the subtype kept for CDP inspection
git kind wears the branch glyph (option C, user pick 2026-09-05)

steps.note: vcs push (VERBATIM frame) + the other kinds (schema enum): merge / rebase read as one word, an unknown kind is treated like a known one

expect.why: push names the branch; merge/rebase are one word; an unrecognised kind shows its own name

steps.note: notification (VERBATIM stop-hook frame): immediate priority draws as a warning line, the TUI's 'ctrl+o to see' suffix is dropped, a repeat with the same key REPLACES the line

frames.text: Stop hook error occurred · ctrl+o to see
Stop hook error occurred again · ctrl+o to see

expect.why: same key replaced in place; a new key is a new line
replaced text, TUI suffix stripped
immediate priority = warning prominence
warning carries the alert icon
low priority stays muted
warning keeps the alert glyph
a plain notice wears the open dot

steps.note: memory_saved / memory_recall (schema-shaped, INFERRED): '<verb> N memories' with the REPL's default verb and singular/plural

expect.why: default verb, custom verb, empty list draws nothing, recall counts
memory kind wears the bookmark

steps.note: code_change_published (schema-shaped, INFERRED): provider + the URL as a link that the system-browser handler will catch

expect.why: provider named, URL shown whole
the URL is an anchor (browseLink opens it in the system browser)
published change wears the link glyph
